help.title: HOW IT WORKS
help.step1.title: 1 · Find your saves
help.step1.body: Press “Find automatically” and the tool looks in the Microsoft Store folder. Or drop the wgs folder or a .sav file onto the window.
help.step2.title: 2 · Check the list
help.step2.body: Tick the saves you need. Slot, date, level and time are shown in the table; “—” means the field could not be read.
help.step3.title: 3 · Convert
help.step3.body: The Steam folder is detected automatically. Press “Convert” and confirm the overwrite if the files already exist.
help.files.title: Where the files live
help.warn.title: Important
help.warn.body: Game Pass achievements do not carry over to Steam. The game must be closed: locked files cannot be overwritten. Source saves are only ever read.
help.dest.title: Several Steam accounts
help.dest.body: If more than one profile exists, pick the right one in the “Account” list.
